original_prompt: ONLY one olive green fabric waist belt with a rectangular olive green covered buckle, detached and arranged in a loose oval. Single accessory studio photograph, large centered on pure white background, entire object visible. No person, no clothing, no dress, no outfit, no mannequin, no shoes, no text or additional objects. Ignore all clothing in reference; recreate only the named accessory.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。文字图案以视觉参考为主，未逐图重生成验证。
